|game_text=Deploy on table. May deploy [Jabba's Palace] Ord Mantell from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Unless Court Of The Vile Gangster on table, [Dagobah] and [Cloud City] bounty hunters are forfeit +2. If opponent's character is about to be forfeited, your bounty hunter present may capture that character (character is first restored to normal). [Immune to Alter.]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[All Wrapped Up (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

May deploy [Jabba's Palace] Ord Mantell from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Unless Court Of The Vile Gangster on table, [Dagobah] and [Cloud City] bounty hunters are forfeit +2. If opponent's character is about to be forfeited, your bounty hunter present may capture that character (character is first restored to normal). [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[All Wrapped Up (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 2 February 2025: “Deploy on table. May deploy [Jabba's Palace] Ord Mantell from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Unless Court Of The Vile Gangster on table, [Dagobah] and [Cloud City] bounty hunters are forfeit +2. If opponent's character is about to be forfeited, your bounty hunter present may capture that character (character is first restored to normal). [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[All Wrapped Up (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•All Wrapped Up”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[All Wrapped Up (V)]] (published 26 December 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[All Wrapped Up]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).

|rulings=* Requires the bounty hunter be present, but does not require the target character to be present.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee card data: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026181124id_/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* The target character applies their forfeit value, but does not leave table. Cards on the target character remain.
* The target character cannot be targeted as 'just lost' or 'just forfeited.'
* Dark can choose from the usual capture options (Seize, Imprison, Escape).
* The captured character's values are restored to normal and if hit, is no longer hit.
